text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... I'm back...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Trainer... fetch me something to drink!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm granting you... the meritorious right...
to
relieve me of my exhaustion. Now,
quickly!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Gulp, gulp... Ahhhh!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I've done it. I've made my debut.
Now, I
can begin running as a
professional.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But this was just the first step. My real
journey
starts now.
Buzz, buzz.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My phone! Ugh... Now of all times! My
speech was
just getting started!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...It's my mother.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Okay. I'll catch up with you when I'm
finished.
Clunk.
Beep.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Good day.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's right. I made my debut. Is
there a
problem?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Sure, my classmates were all
excellent as
well, but I—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It was the same talk as always.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Why debut now? Everyone is so
talented, they're
bound to crush you."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"You're too rash. Come home before you

embarrass yourself."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Quit while you're ahead before you
have to face
whether or not you lack
talent."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But I know the truth, hehe. She doesn't
know what
she's talking about.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Not. At. All!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I've decided, Trainer! My next goal is to
run a G1!
Each race has a grade, or a kind of level.

The grades are as follows from lowest to
highest:
open, G3, G2, and then G1 at
the top.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It only makes sense that a first-rate
Umamusume
wins a G1. Besides, I want
the popularity it will
bring. The
adulation.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
And if I'm going to compete in the
Classics next
year, it's standard that I
get experience not just in
1,600-meter
mile distance races, but medium
races as
well.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
There is one logical course of direction. I
must win
the Hopeful Stakes at the end
of the year and
become the junior
champion.

The Hopeful Stakes is a 2,000-meter

medium-distance race on turf.

Considering how similar it is in distance
with one
of the Triple Crown's Classics,
it's a good
stepping stone for the future.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
After I win that, going on to take the
Triple
Crown won't be such a bad idea.
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It'll be so amazing that no one will be
able to
deny its greatness.
choice_data_list: This looks like it's going to be quite a journey.
This looks like it's going to be quite a journey, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And then, she'll finally understand...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That I never lacked talent to begin with.

Although she speaks with steeled
confidence, her
eyes quiver with
uncertainty.
